metadata.title: The AI Data-Center Backlash Is Real. Why Bloom Energy Stock Is Surging.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
The AI Data-Center Backlash Is Real. Why Bloom Energy Stock Is Surging.
The Democratic sweep of the midterm elections has ramped up the political pressure on the artificial-intelligence data-center buildout. But that’s helping AI power supplier Bloom Energy –the stock was surging 7% ahead of the open Wednesday.
